finding: The probe cached a layer object at creation and read it later. AdaptiveShield single-flattened mode keeps current values in the container and only synchronizes the identity handle when getShieldById is called. A long-lived layer reference may therefore report stale capacity.
nativeCoverageGap: The earlier accounting assertions used a foreign layer, exercising stacked shields; they did not establish single-flattened behavior.

R16 reactive refresh reads through getShieldById
plannedRepair: Measure beam absorption from the production per-layer onHit callback and retire the sample once; add isolated single-shield container absorption and expiry checks.
boundary: Original logs are preserved. Zero recorded consumption is not evidence of zero actual absorption, a damage bypass, or a timing-window cause.
